faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) for filling up research positions in Karnataka.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced in MAHE recruitment?
faq.answer: The position announced is Project Research Scientist I (Medical) under a project-based contract arrangement.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist I (Medical) position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS, BDS, MD in Biochemistry, or an MDS degree to be eligible to apply for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Project Research Scientist I (Medical)?
faq.answer: Applicants must be less than 35 years of age to apply for the Project Research Scientist I (Medical) position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 67,000 plus 10% HRA per month as per the project guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 20-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for MAHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted through Email to the designated official address provided by the academy.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting based on candidate CV and submitted documents, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates send their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates need to send their detailed CV and supporting documents to [email protected] before the closing date.
